cases.name: mismatched JS/WASM rejects initialization, preserves saved checkpoint and correct bytes recover
unsupported schema refuses restore without mutation; unknown custom envelope survives compatible reopen
cancelled browser loading rejects ready, releases recovery and remounts saved data
SSR imports avoid browser globals; mounting there reports the host boundary before any document access
quota error retains edited bytes and report backup restores into a separate database
revoked host write permission denies captured intent without mutation; explicit reauthorization and recapture recover
stale command target cannot overwrite newer content; reselect and recapture deliberately apply once
troubleshooting source/profile/fixture/download ranges and visible navigation are exact
all harnesses block external traffic and lifecycle teardown closes resources

diagnostics.assets: Initialization rejects with an EngineError mentioning a missing WASM export (wasm.__wbindgen_add_to_stack_pointer is not a function in the pinned Chromium run). The editor phase is failed, ready is false and no localCommitted receipt is created.
diagnostics.content: A restore request with schema future.schema.v99 rejects with EngineError / EngineRejected: unsupported identity envelope. Unknown custom data instead has a source fallback: Future kickoff. A fallback does not authorize editing that custom type.
diagnostics.loading: ready rejects with initialization canceled. A visible host element does not establish ready state. A cancelled instance reaches destroyed and releases subscriptions and recovered storage.
diagnostics.ssr: The deliberate null-host server-side mount reports Invalid value used in weak set in pinned Node 24.19.0. This low-level error means no valid browser host was provided; it is not a user-facing SDK diagnostic contract. Importing the public core/web entries alone accesses none of window, document, indexedDB, navigator, fetch or WebAssembly.
diagnostics.quota: QuotaExceededError: Prepared local quota failure. localCommitted is null for the failed edit, and the indicator does not claim Saved locally. Remote save remains not-configured.
diagnostics.permission: The captured intent returns rejected / stale-or-unavailable-command-target; new capture is unavailable and direct public commit throws Editor is read-only.
diagnostics.stale: The captured replace intent returns rejected / stale-or-unavailable-command-target after another admitted edit advances the revision.

scope: One complete final 9/9 invocation against exact sources; prepared faults, actual production engines/browser/storage; 2 separate rendered desktop/mobile reader checks. No OS/provider/remote/registry/release proof.
